news.text: #JUVENTUS, ALL OUT ATTACKLucio, new style#David is also gone, following #Vlahovic and #Openda. The German giant preferred over #Zirkzee. #Woltemade, #Kolo and #Alaj: a completely revamped attackNick arrives on loan: one meter 98 centimeters and eight goals in the Premier League with #Newcastle. #Cabal says no to #Atalanta. #Tagliafico falls through. Anxiety over #Thuram: today the verdict on his knee. [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

YOUR HIGHNESS, #JUVEThe arrivals of #Sarr and #Woltemade confirm the strategy: more height and physical strength in addition to quality.#Carnevali and #Massara deliver a profoundly renewed squad to #Spalletti: 9 new signings. #Sarr and the #Pogba role model: "Enthusiastic to be at a club where #Platini and #Zidane also played". #Ravanelli applauds: "#Juve is much stronger now". #Cabal stays in Turin: no #Tagliafico.[Front Page TuttoSport]

📃 #Rugani, #Cabal, #Thuram, #Zhegrova, #Milik and #Ekhator are the candidates who could be left out of the UEFA squad list.In Serie A, two from among #Cabal, #Zhegrova, #Milik and #Thuram.[@ilbianconerocom via @PuebloJ]

👀❤️‍🔥 "Inside story on #Woltemade: yesterday when some were saying that an agreement with him was not yet in place, in reality it was completely finalized. There was a feeling that a German club, like #BorussiaDortmund, could enter the race, but he voluntarily sent a message to a #Juventus director: 'I am joining you, ignore whoever says there is no agreement or that I am not convinced. I can't wait to join. I see you as the best opportunity, I want to play and be a key player'."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

⚡️🧐 "On #Tagliafico, #Juventus found themselves in a somewhat uncomfortable situation with #Cabal, as in realty, they didn't actually want to push him out. #Roma called, #Atalanta had been working on him for two days, at 6:00 PM even #Bologna called back, but the situation blocked and so the bianconero club did not sign the Argentine, who was ready to sign with #AtléticoMadrid."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴🤔 "#Atalanta made an attempt for #Cabal: #Juventus sent it right back to the sender simply because they needed to find an alternative on the left and the Colombian can adapt to that position."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹👀 "A short while ago, I reported #Porto's appreciation for #Gatti. We will see if this attempt succeeds and if it develops any real depth. The #Juventus defender would like to play more, and #Farioli's appreciation for him is total and absolute."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

BREAKING: Joshua Zirkzee to Everton on loan is close to being agreed.[Ben Jacobs]

❌ Nicolas #Tagliafico had been waiting for several hours for the green light to sign with #AtléticoMadrid, but the transfer has collapsed, according to L'Equipe. The Argentine will therefore remain at #Olympiquelyonnais.[RMC Sport]

‼️#JNextGen, the deal finalized with #Carrarese went under the radar. The arrival of Filippo #Melegoni, a player of a higher division, a quality addition for someone who knows him well like Massimo #Brambilla. A swap like the one with Niccolò #Cudrig that is equivalent to the Seedorf-Coco one.[Mirko Di Natale]

Thought of the Day 💭Although Spalletti was one of the main characters responsible for Juventus experiencing their worst season in 15 years, the coach remained in the job.Carnevali and Massara have consulted Spalletti in the process and assembled a team of players with the qualities that he has been asking for, - it may still not be 100% flawless, but all this will be fairly included when assessments and analyses of the season's performances and results are made on an ongoing basis.One thing is certain: Comolli, Di Gregorio, David and Openda has all left the club, which basically drags Spalletti to the front-row of responsibility. All the best, Jonathan! 👋 [Juventus] https://t.me/GJustjuve/72652JONATHAN DAVID JOINS ATLETICO MADRID ON LOANJonathan David has left Juventus on loan, joining Spanish side Atletico Madrid for the 2026/27 season.The 26-year-old striker arrived in Turin in July 2025, following spells in Belgium and France.He made a total of 46 appearances for the Men’s First Team last season across domestic and European competitions, scoring eight goals, plus one further appearance at the start of the 26/27 season.Good luck, Jonathan![Juventus]
